title: audit detail mail.read
description: detail of audit rows with action mail.read: a session read a mailbox with the operation mail.find (ADR-099 section 7); the mailbox is target_id (target_kind credential). The operation, the mailbox's owner, the folder looked at, the number of mails answered, the seconds waited, whether the wait ran out and the outcome - never an address, subject, text or link. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
